activity.notes: 1537 is a source-attested REPRESENTATIVE POINT for Lempira (also Elempira / El Empira) leading Lenca resistance to the Spanish around Cerquín in western Honduras, not an asserted complete reign or exact year of death. A 1558 Rodrigo Ruiz probanza, published in modern research, independently attests the commander but offers a self-interested account of his death that differs from the later parley-assassination narrative. Do not encode 1558 as an Activity year: it is the retrospective document date. The term 'Cerquín Lenca Chiefdom' is a narrow local political association for the indigenous leader, not proof that all Lenca peoples formed one unified sovereign state.

sources.title: Universidad Nacional Autónoma de Honduras, 20 de julio de 2026: Día del Cacique Lempira
sources.citation_text: UNAH explains Rodrigo Ruiz's Probanza de Méritos prepared in 1558 and its historicity evidence for Lempira/Elempira, noting differing death narratives.

sources.citation_text: Independent historical critique places Elempira's anti-Spanish resistance and rival narrative of his killing around 1537, with documentary reservations about Ruiz's testimony.

sources.citation_text: Historical secondary narrative of the 1537 Lenca revolt and the chieftain Lempira; differs from later Ruiz documentation on the death mechanism.

spatial_disposition.evidence: 2026-10-12: Reviewed narrow Cerquín-centered Lenca authority and anti-Spanish resistance from UNAH 2026, https://blogs.unah.edu.hn/presencia-universitaria/20-de-julio-de-2026-dia-del-cacique-lempira-pilar-identitario-en-honduras and Moreno 2021, https://guaymuras.hn/cienciassocialeslibro.php?idweb=54. The identity and delimitation of a standalone Cerquín chiefdom versus broader Lenca communities has not been resolved against live canonical Polities. No verified Place UUID, geographic bounds or precise seat: preserve reviewed_hold and avoid a fabricated all-Lenca unified country.
